Second, we postulate that the dark energy \u2014 which drives the accelerated expansion of the universe \u2014 is represented by a cosmological constant \u039b, or, equivalently, a vacuum energy with constant density \u03c1_\u039b = {\u03b1_g}\u2074 \u03c1_P, where \u03b1_g = m\u2080\/M_P is the gravitational coupling constant, M_P is the Planck mass and \u03c1_P is the Planck density.
